method.headline_construct: AI Work Pressure Rank: relative GenAI task exposure, not an outcome probability
method.multi_mapping: Median of scored official ISCO-08 matches; all official candidates, scored values, ranges, SD_2025 and potential25 categories retained
method.source_score_scale: ILO mean_score_2025 and task_score_sd_2025 are stored on a 0 to 1 scale; the UI may display the same values multiplied by 100 and labelled /100.
method.ranking: Midrank percentile among scored SSOC 2024 occupations, rounded to one decimal
method.sidecars: Nullable independent evidence blocks; none can change the AI Work Pressure Rank
method.detailed_tasks: Withheld at five-digit occupation grain. SSOC 2024 publishes task statements at four-digit unit-group grain, and V9 does not copy them down to detailed occupations. Attributed ILO task rows are published separately at four-digit ISCO grain and never change the headline rank.

reasons: Official ESCO v1.1.0 occupation rows and the human-validated ESCO-O*NET v1 crosswalk are frozen with source checksums.
Only exact and close relations are candidate inputs; broad and narrow relations are excluded.
Broad many-to-many transfer remains withheld; data/v9-research-signals.json publishes only a reviewed one-identity subset and cannot affect the headline.

taxonomy.title: Sustainability project development/management professional
taxonomy.detailed_definition: Sustainability project development/management professional assesses and develops environmental projects, such as carbon credit and renewable energy projects for businesses to reduce emissions. In the upstream phase of the project, he/she assesses the viability of the project by conducting pre-feasibility studies and analysis, structures and seeks project financing, and registers the project under certification standards. Where suitable methodologies do not exist under these standards, he/she develops the appropriate frameworks and methodologies to credibly assess and develop the project. When the project is ongoing, he/she oversees the development and Implementation of the project and prepares project documentation and reports. He/she also ensures that the projects adhere to the latest regulatory procedures and achieves certification standards throughout the project lifecycle. He/she may also negotiate contracts with project owners.

minor_group.title: PHYSICAL AND ENGINEERING SCIENCE TECHNICIANS I

taxonomy.detailed_definition: Chemical engineering technician (petrochemical) performs technical tasks, normally under the direction of a chemical engineer (petroleum), contributory to development of processes for manufacturing petrochemicals.
